coordinates.note: Campus-grade: the OpenStreetMap outline of the plant. The CONNIE laboratory is a shipping container outside the Angra 2 reactor building, 30 m from the core; its exact position is not published in the sources read.

summary.plain: A temporary laboratory in a shipping container beside the Angra 2 reactor building in Brazil, 30 metres from the reactor core, where the CONNIE silicon-sensor array sits with no rock cover.
summary.technical: Shipping-container laboratory outside the main Angra 2 reactor building (surface, no overburden), 30 m from the core of a 3.8 GW_th reactor. Marked with a campus-grade point for the plant.
